# Week Cluster

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

Everything the system produces about a single week — its index, plan, log, review, journal, analysis, health and meal-plan notes — taken as one whole rather than many notes of one kind.

## Scope note

A sibling of DayCluster and MonthCluster under TimeCluster, not a rung between them: the week's own notes are its parts, and a day's belong to DayCluster.
